purpose: Starter index of reusable lessons; not a complete repository ingestion.

records.title: Quarantine preserves malformed legacy source without guessing
records.lesson: Pin the original bytes, quarantine only the exact known failure, and record malformed expressions verbatim. Do not invent replacement semantics.
records.limits: Verification establishes source identity and CI exclusion, not that the quarantined module compiles or that intended values are known.

records.title: Compare snapshots without collapsing disconnected histories
records.lesson: Use exact commit and blob evidence to preserve file-level identity; do not infer a shared history or its cause when the compare evidence does not establish one.
records.limits: This record describes the documented comparison snapshot, not a fresh complete audit of every branch.

records.title: Append-only correction proposals preserve original JOB events
records.lesson: Store correction proposals and review decisions separately from original events; derive a corrected view only from explicitly accepted decisions.
records.limits: The implementation was recorded in the supplied Stride snapshot history; this catalog entry does not claim current runtime or cross-branch compatibility.

records.title: Read-only context can connect observations without adjudicating them
records.lesson: Contextual links and creative combinations should remain labeled as links or hypotheses; unresolved relationships are not facts.
records.limits: Observed design and test artifacts do not establish sentience, external discovery, or factual correctness of generated associations.

records.title: Vector similarity is retrieval metadata, not truth or consent
records.lesson: Treat semantic distance as a candidate retrieval signal only. Before personal interaction data is ingested, define consent, minimization, retention, deletion, provenance, and review.
records.limits: The file's existence and implementation were inspected; no privacy, retention, or retrieval-quality audit is claimed.

records.title: Generated self-corrections must not overwrite original traces
records.lesson: Preserve an input trace and store any generated alternative as a linked proposal. A simulated judge is not a validated authority.
records.limits: This is a code-reading lesson, not a runtime security or correctness assessment.

records.title: Branch-local text transformations require explicit scope review
records.lesson: A branch-local transformation policy must not be applied globally without an explicit compatibility decision. Preserve its exact source and record unresolved scope.
records.limits: The catalog does not infer who introduced altered numeric glyphs in other files or whether those changes were intentional.
